mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_PermissionMatrix removes the closed-world definition of PermMatrix.Allowed. The injection then adds AC_MemberNonOwner -> Op_PatchTask to Allowed, which directly violates the LeastPrivilege and FR_009 assertions that no non-owner member may PATCH.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_PermMatrixViolation { AC_MemberNonOwner -> Op_PatchTask in PermMatrix.Allowed }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_EachTaskHasCreatedEntry removes the guarantee that every task has a CK_Created audit entry. The injection forces a task with no CK_Created entry to exist, making AuditCompleteness, FR_015_AuditPerEditEvent and FR_006_OwnerImmutable all find counterexamples.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_MissingCreatedEntry { some t: Task | no ae: AuditEntry | ae.ae_task = t and ae.ae_change = CK_Created }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing this fact removes the requirement that deleted tasks retain a CK_Deleted audit entry. The injection forces a deleted task with no CK_Deleted entry, directly violating FR_016_AuditOutlivesTask and showing the audit trail did not survive deletion.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_MissingDeletedEntry { some t: Task | t in Graveyard.deleted_tasks and (no ae: AuditEntry | ae.ae_task = t and ae.ae_change = CK_Deleted) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing this fact removes the snapshot-correctness constraint on actor_role. The injection creates an AuditEntry where a MemberRole user is recorded as AdminRole, directly violating AttributionCorrectness and FR_010_AdminAuditRoleSnapshot.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_WrongRoleSnapshot { some ae: AuditEntry, m: TeamMembership | ae.ae_actor = m.tm_user and ae.ae_team = m.tm_team and m.tm_role = MemberRole and ae.ae_actor_role = AdminRole }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing this fact removes the team-scope guard on operations. The injection forces an operation whose op_task belongs to a different team, directly leaking cross-team task visibility and violating cross-team isolation assertions.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_CrossTeamLeak { some op: Operation, t: Task | t in op.op_task and t.task_team != op.op_team }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing this fact removes the gate that every operation must appear in PermMatrix.Allowed. The injection forces an operation with AC_MemberNonOwner context executing Op_DeleteTask, which is denied in the matrix, causing LeastPrivilege and OwnershipBasedAccess to find counterexamples.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_UnauthorizedOperation { some op: Operation | op.op_context = AC_MemberNonOwner and op.op_kind = Op_DeleteTask }
